filter.title: Filter
filter.emptyBody: Try another filter, or go back to All.

search.emptyBody: Try a different term, or clear the search.

group.overflowEmpty: Nothing in this group right now.

machine.empty: No conversations on this machine yet.

save.title: Save this conversation to your account?
save.body: Once saved it shows up in your conversation list, and you can still read it after this machine is shut down — or even removed.
save.point1: Its title and full record are stored on AgentRe's server
save.point2: Conversations you never save are not uploaded at all
save.point3: You can delete it at any time — the server's copy and the executing machine's copy go together

delete.title: Delete this conversation?
delete.online: It is removed from your account and also deleted from “{{machine}}”. This cannot be undone.
delete.onlineDesktop: It is removed from your account and also deleted from “{{machine}}”. That machine runs the Agentre app: what gets deleted there is the conversation itself on that computer, not a record of a run. This cannot be undone.
delete.offline: It is removed from your account right away. “{{machine}}” is offline, so its copy is cleared the next time it comes online. This cannot be undone.
delete.offlineDesktop: It is removed from your account right away. “{{machine}}” is offline, so the next time it comes online it deletes the conversation itself on that computer, not a record of a run. This cannot be undone.
delete.unknownPeer: It is removed from your account right away. The machine that runs it clears its own copy the next time it connects. This cannot be undone.
